title: Kobalos Malware Investigation
description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised Linux host infected with the Kobalos malware. Your goal is to identify persistence mechanisms, detect command-and-control (C2) communication, and trace lateral movement to other hosts in the network.
outcomes: Identify persistence mechanisms hidden in systemd services and timers
Detect active network listeners and outbound C2 connections
Trace lateral movement via SSH and rsync
Analyze shell scripts deployed as malware payloads
Correlate log evidence across multiple hosts

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised Linux host infected with the Kobalos malware. Your goal is to identify persistence mechanisms, detect command-and-control (C2) communication, and trace lateral movement to other hosts in the network.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the target host via SSH using the provided credentials. Enter the word 'start' to progress to the next level.
levels.local_content: Access the target host via SSH using the provided credentials. Enter the word 'start' to progress to the next level.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Investigate the running services on the target host. Identify the suspicious service that is listening on port 8080 and serving the contents of the inventory log file. The flag is the name of the suspicious service.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services running on the target host and look for any services listening on port 8080.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services running on the target host and look for any services listening on port 8080.

levels.title: Identify Service Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service identified in Task 1 is maintained on the system. Identify the persistence mechanism used to ensure the service starts automatically. The flag is the name of the persistence mechanism.
levels.solution: Examine the systemd timers and services to find the persistence mechanism for the suspicious service.

levels.title: Identify Data Exfiltration
levels.content: Analyze the network connections and logs to identify the data exfiltration mechanism. Determine the file being exfiltrated and the destination IP address. The flag is the file being exfiltrated and the destination IP address.
levels.solution: Check the network connections and logs on the target host to identify the data exfiltration mechanism.
